tools.name: search_plugins
tools.description: Search third-party plugins for OBS Studio listed in Plugin Soko-kun. Only plugins whose latest checked release passed automated checks are returned. Files are always free to download from public GitHub releases. Paid-only distributions without public source are not listed. Pricing and asset restrict

tools.name: get_plugin
tools.description: Get details of an OBS Studio plugin by its id (owner/repository). Download links are included only for listed plugins. Files are always free to download from public GitHub releases. Paid-only distributions without public source are not listed. Pricing and asset restrictions are declared by authors a

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "search_plugins" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
